name: Mahjong for a Cause
description: Founded by Robin Hall; each event supports a local nonprofit. Held at Hall's Hall in downtown Friendswood. Organizer's booking page: "Complete all 72 hands on the 2026 NMJL Card" (A League of Your Own series). Organizer's event pages also say players should be comfortable with NMJL rules. Mahjong 101 lessons offered. Open to the public.
address: Hall's Hall, 906 Anna Lane, Friendswood, TX 77546
schedule: Open play Tue-Sat several times weekly ($10-$15 per session listed); Mahjong 101 lessons $40; leagues $99
